Method.name: invokePostService
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC= $$$OK $$$TRACE(" Inside InvokePostService ")
try { set jsonBodyData = pInput.Read(.len,.status) $$$TRACE(" JSON (Hie Patient ALias Service) : "_jsonBodyData)
set jsonObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.Service.PatientAliasServiceDemographics).%New() do jsonObj.%JSONImport(jsonBodyData)
set mrnsObjList = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() set mrnsObjList = jsonObj.MRNS
FOR index=1:1:mrnsObjList.Count() { $$$TRACE("EMPI::" _mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).CMRN) $$$TRACE("MRNtype:" _mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).AliasType) $$$TRACE("mrnToAdd:" _mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).MrnToAdd)
set pResponse = ##class(IHC.ITF.Service.patientalias.MRNs).%New() set pResponse.CMRN = mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).CMRN set pResponse.AliasType = mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).AliasType set pResponse.MrnToAdd = mrnsObjList.GetAt(index).MrnToAdd For iTarget=1:1:$L(..TargetConfigNames, ",") { Set tOneTarget=$ZStrip($P(..TargetConfigNames,",",iTarget),"<>W") $$$TRACE("tOneTarget " _ tOneTarget) do ..SendRequestAsync(tOneTarget,pResponse) } } }catch e { $$$TRACE(" Unknown Exception: " _ e) set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText("Unknown Exception while receiving post request from patient alias service "_e) Set tSC = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).DisableMsgError(..%ConfigName,errTxt) set tSC = $$$OK
} quit tSC
